description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under excise duty on every article specified in the column I, II and III of the schedule here to, shall be payable at the rate specified in the corresponding entry column IV with effect from 25th July, 2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of excise duty rates on specific goods through an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It involves regulatory changes to taxation rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content fits Legal/Regulatory as it constitutes a statutory instrument modifying existing regulations.
